component.name: Crimson
component.summary: Download and convert online videos and audio streams

description.p: Crimson is a desktop graphical client powered by yt-dlp and FFmpeg for downloading and converting online media streams for offline archiving.
Built with Python and Qt6 (PySide6), it executes network extraction and stream multiplexing on secondary worker threads to keep the interface responsive during transfers.

ul.li: Download video streams in 4K (2160p), Full HD (1080p), HD (720p), and 480p in MP4 or MKV containers
Extract audio tracks directly into MP3 (320kbps or 192kbps) and uncompressed WAV formats
Control playlist behavior to download either a single media link or an entire playlist
Customize the interface with six curated visual themes, including Frutiger Aero with optional animations
Switch instantly between 25 supported languages at runtime

description.p: Flatpak sandbox compliance, vector iconography, and Linux desktop integration update:

ul.li: Added XDG_DATA_HOME sandbox directory support for persistent configuration storage
Added Flatpak runtime detection to delegate dependency updates to the package manager
Updated application icon with a 512x512 high-resolution PNG and scalable SVG
Registered canonical reverse-DNS desktop entry identifier for Wayland window association

description.p: Complete migration to PySide6 (Qt6) with asynchronous multi-threaded architecture, Frutiger Aero visual identity, and support for 25 languages.
